# Synthetic fixtures

These minimal HTML fragments were written for this project. They reproduce only
the metadata attributes and DOM selectors needed by tests. They contain no
copied article text, real browsing history, personal data, or Zotero library
records.

`scopus-detail.html` and `scopus-search-results.html` are synthetic fixtures for
the verified Scopus document-detail and Table/List search-result selectors.
